discussion.body: Reply to existing Mist note. Standing as design: mist on Bengenia cannot be burned off, blown out, or purified into clear weather. The Temple of Mist governs weather, form, and visibility by keeping the veil in place, not by lifting it. The major event is the Act 3 variation (see FEAT-016 and FEAT-021): Velith overdraws the veil, or Nyxara answers a Mist prayer, and the Pale Kingdom region is wiped as a travel hub. That is a scar on the single ending, not a second ending. Seris (FEAT-031) has a death crisis inside that wipe; if she already left with the party she can survive it. Temple feats are FEAT-021 through FEAT-026. FEAT-003 can be closed when those six are accepted.
